query:
SELECT
            DATE_TRUNC('month', r.created_at) AS "month_start!",
            COALESCE(SUM(r.cost_microdollars), 0)::BIGINT AS "cost!",
            COUNT(*)::BIGINT AS "requests!"
        FROM ai_requests r
        WHERE r.created_at >= DATE_TRUNC('month', NOW()) - ($1::INT * INTERVAL '1 month')
        GROUP BY 1
        ORDER BY 1
